Alberta on track for deadliest year on roads in a decade

Alberta is projected to experience the highest number of traffic fatalities in a decade, with 2026 potentially recording 274 deaths if current trends continue, according to the Alberta RCMP. This projection suggests a significant increase in road deaths compared to previous years. The situation has been described as a 'disaster waiting to happen'.
